```{python Navigation header, results='asis'}
from IPython.display import display, HTML
```

## Introduction

This report compares block-IF2 parameter estimates for the mixed panel measles
model in `pypomp` and R `panelPomp`. Both implementations run the same number
of iterations from the same committed starting points
(`../starting_parameters.csv`) with the same perturbation sizes, so the
distributions of final estimates should agree.

The panel has 4 units (London, Halesworth, Hastings and Cardiff), and the
parameters are mixed:

- **Shared** across units: `R0`, `sigma`, `gamma`, `sigmaSE`, `cohort`, `amplitude`.
- **Unit-specific**: `iota`, `rho`, `psi`, `S_0`, `E_0`, `I_0`, `R_0`.

`pypomp` reports the shared parameters on every unit's row. We collapse them
to a single `shared` entry so that each start counts once. Parameters are
compared on the estimation scale (log for rates, logit for probabilities and
initial-state fractions), which is the scale block-IF2 perturbs on.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### Why the covariates are imported from `pomp`
The Python and R smoothing spline implementations interpolate the birth rate
and population covariates differently, most noticeably for Cardiff. We
therefore export the interpolated covariate grid from `pomp` into
`../R_covariates.csv` and use it in the `pypomp` objects, so that both packages
search over the same model.
:::

The `pypomp` run continues past the search into a panel-specific step:
mix-and-match across units, then pruning to the single best combination.
`panelPomp` has no equivalent, so the comparison with R uses
`results_final.csv`, which is saved before that step. The mix-and-match result
is reported separately.

```{python Load results}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import checks
from plotnine import ggplot, aes, geom_density, geom_line, facet_wrap, labs

os.environ["JAX_PLATFORMS"] = "cpu"

PLATFORMS = {
    "R panelPomp": os.path.join("results", "R"),
    "pypomp (GPU)": ru.platform_dir(),
}
runs = ru.load_timing_data(PLATFORMS)

PY_DIR = ru.platform_dir()
R_DIR = os.path.join("results", "R")

py_results = ru.read_if_exists(os.path.join(PY_DIR, "results_final.csv"))
r_coefs = ru.read_if_exists(os.path.join(R_DIR, "mif_coefs.csv"))

long_frames = []
if py_results is not None:
    long_frames.append(
        ru.split_shared_specific(ru.wide_results_to_long(py_results, "pypomp"))
    )
if r_coefs is not None:
    long_frames.append(ru.r_coefs_to_long(r_coefs))

combined = pd.concat(long_frames, ignore_index=True) if long_frames else pd.DataFrame(
    columns=["unit", "param", "value", "source"]
)
combined = combined[combined["param"].isin(ru.LOG_PARAMS + ru.LOGIT_PARAMS)]
transformed = ru.to_estimation_scale(combined)

py_ll = ru.read_if_exists(os.path.join(PY_DIR, "pfilter_logliks.csv"))
r_ll = ru.read_if_exists(os.path.join(R_DIR, "pfilter_logliks.csv"))
ll_frames = []
if py_ll is not None:
    ll_frames.append(py_ll.assign(source="pypomp"))
if r_ll is not None:
    ll_frames.append(r_ll.assign(source="R panelPomp"))
per_unit = (
    pd.concat(ll_frames, ignore_index=True)
    .groupby(["source", "unit", "theta_idx"])["logLik"]
    .agg(logmeanexp=ru.logmeanexp)
    .reset_index()
    if ll_frames
    else pd.DataFrame(columns=["source", "unit", "theta_idx", "logmeanexp"])
)
```

```{python Missing sources, results='asis'}
    ("R panelPomp endpoint log-likelihoods", r_ll, os.path.join(R_DIR, "pfilter_logliks.csv")),
):
    if df is None:
        display(HTML(ru.missing_note(label, path)))
```

## Automated checks

```{python Automated checks, results='asis'}
COMPARED = "pypomp vs R panelPomp"
blocks = ["shared"] + sorted(u for u in transformed["unit"].dropna().unique() if u != "shared")
estimates = {
    block: [
        (param, g[g["source"] == "pypomp"]["value"], g[g["source"] == "R panelPomp"]["value"])
        for param, g in transformed[transformed["unit"] == block].groupby("param")
    ]
    for block in blocks
}
endpoint = [
    (unit, g[g["source"] == "pypomp"]["logmeanexp"], g[g["source"] == "R panelPomp"]["logmeanexp"])
    for unit, g in per_unit.groupby("unit")
]
M_TESTS = 2 * (sum(len(s) for s in estimates.values()) + len(endpoint))

rows, details = [], []
for block, samples in estimates.items():
    r, det = checks.group_checks(samples, "Final estimates", f"{block}: {COMPARED}", M_TESTS)
    rows += r
    details.append(det)
r, det = checks.group_checks(endpoint, "Endpoint log-likelihood", COMPARED, M_TESTS)
rows += r
details.append(det)

level = checks.run_level(runs)
rows = checks.gate_smoke(rows, level)
checks.save(rows, level, pypomp_version=runs["pypomp (GPU)"]["meta"].get("pypomp_version"))
display(HTML(checks.table_html(rows, M_TESTS)))
display(HTML(checks.details_html(pd.concat(details, ignore_index=True), "Results for each parameter and unit")))
```

## Visual review

- [Shared parameter distributions](#shared-parameter-distributions) and [unit-specific parameter distributions](#unit-specific-parameter-distributions): the `pypomp` and `panelPomp` densities should overlap heavily for each parameter.
- [Endpoint log-likelihoods](#endpoint-log-likelihoods): the densities should overlap heavily for each unit.
- [Convergence traces](#convergence-traces): traces from independent starts should converge toward a common region.

```{python Summary table}
if transformed.empty:

        transformed.groupby(["unit", "source", "param"])["value"]
        .agg(n="count", mean="mean", sd="std", min="min", max="max")
```

## Shared parameter distributions

```{python Shared densities, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7}
shared = transformed[transformed["unit"] == "shared"]
if shared.empty:
    display(HTML("<p><em>No shared parameter estimates available.</em></p>"))
else:
    display(
        ggplot(shared, aes(x="value", fill="source", color="source"))
        + geom_density(alpha=0.35)
        + facet_wrap("~param", scales="free")
        + labs(
            title="Block-IF2 estimates of the shared parameters",
            subtitle="Estimation scale; one density per implementation",
            x="Parameter value",
            y="Density",
            fill="Source",
            color="Source",
        )
        + ru.scale_fill_premium()
        + ru.scale_color_premium()
        + ru.theme_premium
    )
```

## Unit-specific parameter distributions

```{python Specific densities, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8}
specific = transformed[transformed["unit"] != "shared"]

    for unit in sorted(specific["unit"].dropna().unique()):
        unit_data = specific[specific["unit"] == unit]
        display(
            ggplot(unit_data, aes(x="value", fill="source", color="source"))
            + geom_density(alpha=0.35)

            + labs(
```

## Endpoint log-likelihoods

We re-evaluate each start's final parameter vector with the particle filter and
take the `logmeanexp` over replicate filters, giving one value per start and
unit.

```{python Endpoint logliks, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
if not per_unit.empty:
    display(
        ggplot(per_unit, aes(x="logmeanexp", fill="source", color="source"))
        + geom_density(alpha=0.35)
        + facet_wrap("~unit", scales="free")
        + labs(
            title="Per-unit log-likelihood across search endpoints",
            subtitle="One logmeanexp value per start per implementation",
            x="Log-likelihood",
            y="Density",
            fill="Source",
            color="Source",
        )
        + ru.scale_fill_premium()
        + ru.scale_color_premium()
        + ru.theme_premium
    )
```

## Mix-and-match

`panelPomp` fits each start as one parameter vector. `pypomp` can also
recombine the best unit-specific blocks across starts and refit, which has no
counterpart in `panelPomp`. The table below is the pruned best combination
after that step.

```{python Mix and match}
pruned = ru.read_if_exists(os.path.join(PY_DIR, "results.csv"))
if pruned is None:
    display(HTML(ru.missing_note("pypomp mix-and-match result",
                                 os.path.join(PY_DIR, "results.csv"))))
else:
    display(HTML(pruned.round(4).to_html(classes="table table-striped table-hover", index=False)))
```

## Convergence traces

```{python Traces, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8}
target_cols = ["unit", "theta_idx", "replicate", "iteration", "method", "logLik", "loglik"] + ru.LOG_PARAMS + ru.LOGIT_PARAMS

py_traces = ru.load_traces(os.path.join(PY_DIR, "traces.csv.gz"), "pypomp", usecols=target_cols, max_iters=20)

r_trace_path = os.path.join(R_DIR, "mif_traces.csv.gz")
if not os.path.exists(r_trace_path):
    r_trace_path = os.path.join(R_DIR, "traces.csv.gz")
r_traces = ru.load_traces(r_trace_path, "R panelPomp", usecols=target_cols, max_iters=20)

trace_frames = []
if py_traces is not None:
    if "method" in py_traces.columns:
        py_traces = py_traces[py_traces["method"] == "mif"]
    py_traces = ru.split_traces_shared_specific(py_traces)
    py_long = ru.to_long(py_traces, max_iters=20)
    trace_frames.append(py_long)

if r_traces is not None:
    if "method" in r_traces.columns:
        r_traces = r_traces[r_traces["method"] == "mif"]
    r_traces = ru.split_traces_shared_specific(r_traces)
    r_long = ru.to_long(r_traces, max_iters=20)
    trace_frames.append(r_long)

missing_traces = []
if py_traces is None:
    missing_traces.append(("pypomp traces", os.path.join(PY_DIR, "traces.csv.gz")))
if r_traces is None:
    missing_traces.append(("R panelPomp traces", os.path.join(R_DIR, "mif_traces.csv.gz")))

for label, path in missing_traces:
    display(HTML(ru.missing_note(label, path)))

if trace_frames:
    long = pd.concat(trace_frames, ignore_index=True)
    long = long.dropna(subset=["param_value"])
    long = ru.to_estimation_scale(long, param_col="quantity", value_col="param_value")
    long["group_id"] = long["source"].astype(str) + "_" + long["rep"].astype(str)

    unit_col = "unit" if "unit" in long.columns else None
    groups = sorted(long[unit_col].dropna().unique()) if unit_col else [None]
    for unit in groups:
        data = long[long[unit_col] == unit] if unit_col else long
        if data.empty:
            continue
        data = data.copy()
        data["quantity"] = data["quantity"].astype(str)
        display(
            ggplot(data, aes(x="iter", y="param_value", group="group_id", color="source"))
            + geom_line(alpha=0.2, size=0.4)
            + facet_wrap("~quantity", scales="free_y")
            + labs(
                title=f"Block-IF2 iteration traces{f': {unit}' if unit else ''}",
                x="IF2 iteration",
                y="Value",
                color="Source",
            )
            + ru.scale_color_premium()
            + ru.theme_premium
        )
```
